const axios = require("axios")
const cheerio = require("cheerio")

async function getTTSave(videoUrl) {
  const url = "https://ttsave.app/download"

  const res = await axios.post(
    url,
    {
      query: videoUrl,
      language_id: "2"
    },
    {
      headers: {
        "accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
        "content-type": "application/json",
        "origin": "https://ttsave.app",
        "referer": "https://ttsave.app/id",
        "user-agent":
          "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 6.0; Nexus 5 Build/MRA58N) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"
      }
    }
  )

  const html = res.data
  const $ = cheerio.load(html)

  const videoNoWM = $('a[type="no-watermark"]').attr("href") || null
  const audio = $('a[type="audio"]').attr("href") || null
  const videoWM = $('a[type="watermark"]').attr("href") || null

  return {
    code: 200,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    data: {
      video_no_watermark: videoNoWM,
      video_watermark: videoWM,
      audio_mp3: audio
    }
  }
}
